Day backgrounds

Your nine, then forty more built on the same mechanism. Switch to Matched orb to see each one with a colourful orb: several hues running into each other along the lines. Tap any one to open the real app on it.

Light makes the depth, not colour.A light source, its falloff, a horizon. The orb gets a place to stand.
Colour stays under a whisper.No hue you could name. A named hue fights the blue.
The only warmth is the blue's opposite.Paper and haze sit across from blue, so the blue reads bluer.
Tints only in balance.Pearl mixes three, so the sum stays white.
Grain gives it a material.Print, not screen.
